text:
alex.support: FYI ACME reported a big invoice delta for month-end. Dashboard shows ~2.1M tokens, invoice charged ~2.6M. Can we triage?
priya.finance: Seen this. Pulling invoice line items now — there's a ~500k token delta on the 'standard-text' line for 2026-03-31.
tom.eng: Any quick repro or request IDs from the customer? Could be double-ingestion or a billing job replay.
maya.custsuccess: I asked ACME for sample request IDs; they sent back two they saw in the UI: req_abc123 and req_def456. Also they saw a spike around 23:59 UTC.
alex.support: Notes from ops: billing_aggregator job ran at 2026-03-31T23:59:00Z, then again at 2026-04-01T00:01:10Z due to transient S3 read error. Logs attached below.

alex.support: ```
[2026-03-31T23:59:00Z] billing-agg: start run_id=null, batch_id=chunk-20260331-23
[2026-03-31T23:59:05Z] billing-agg: processed 1,245,789 token events
[2026-04-01T00:00:58Z] billing-agg: S3 read error (503), retrying
[2026-04-01T00:01:10Z] billing-agg: start run_id=null, batch_id=chunk-20260331-23  # duplicate ingestion
[2026-04-01T00:01:20Z] billing-agg: processed 1,245,600 token events
```

tom.eng: That looks like the root cause — aggregator run doesn't persist/require a run_id dedupe, so a retry reprocessed same chunk and wrote token totals twice into billing_ledger.
priya.finance: Can you show SQL to find duplicate ingestion markers so we can compute exact delta we should credit?
tom.eng: Sure — run something like:```sql
SELECT event_id, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM billing_events
WHERE event_timestamp >= '2026-03-31'::date
  AND event_timestamp < '2026-04-01'::date
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

tom.eng: Quick result from staging replica: top duplicates sum to ~498,912 tokens (gpt-small 298,401; gpt-medium 200,511).
maya.custsuccess: ACME wants an ETA for a fix and a customer-facing explanation.
priya.finance: Proposed action: issue provisional credit for 498,912 tokens, mark invoice as "adjustment pending" and create a formal billing adjustment PR. We'll need model-level breakdown for accounting.
tom.eng: Engineers will: 1) enforce run_id persistence and dedupe on aggregator writes, 2) add idempotency header and check before ingest, 3) add a post-run reconciliation check to surface >0.1% duplicates. Patch target: next staging deploy window (non-critical-hotfix) but we can hotfix if finance needs faster. Estimated ETA: patch + tests in 6 hours, deploy to staging in 8, prod in next maintenance window (up to 24h).
meter-bot: billing-agg: run 2311112222 completed with warning duplicate_event_count=4321 duplicate_token_total=498912
priya.finance: I'll draft the credit memo and provisional adjustment now. Please attach the model-level CSV so accounting can post.
tom.eng: Dropping CSV to the run artifacts. Example snippet:```csv
model,duplicate_tokens
gpt-small,298401
gpt-medium,200511
```

jenkins-deploy: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2311116000 (can be moved up on call).
maya.custsuccess: I'll tell ACME we found cross-run replay during EOM processing caused duplicate token writes. We're issuing a credit for 498,912 tokens and will follow up with a postmortem + preventive fix.
alex.support: Action owners: priya.finance = credit & invoice adjust, tom.eng = fix + tests, maya.custsuccess = customer comms. Tagging @eng-oncall and @finance to review. :eyes:
priya.finance: Thanks. Filing internal billing incident and will coordinate ledger reversal once eng confirms corrected ledger state.
